description: Use this when the user wants an exact price to ship their vehicle internationally. Ask the user for every required detail, including THEIR OWN email address; never invent one. For cars and 4x4s also ask for the make and model and the year. The price is not returned in this chat: IVSS emails the user a link, and the exact price with sailings is shown when they open it. Only call this after the user has agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the price (privacy policy: https://ivssuk.com/privacy-policy/).

from_country.description: Country shipping from, English name, e.g. "United Kingdom"

personal_effects.description: True if belongings will be packed inside the vehicle

ship_date.description: When the user wants to ship, YYYY-MM-DD

to_country.description: Country shipping to, English name, e.g. "Australia"

user_agreed_privacy.description: True only if the user agreed to IVSS handling their details to prepare the price

name: request_exact_quote
title: Get an exact IVSS price by email (Instant pricing)
